content.text:
I fixed the misspelling in all three files and committed it as one commit, `5b31c78`, so `git revert 5b31c78` undoes all of it at once.

There was one bad row in each file: `R2510-002` in October, `R2511-004` in November and `R2512-003` in December. `scripts/check.sh` passed before the commit, and no `wholsale` is left in `data/`.

**Commit message:** CLAUDE.md says to start with the data month, because the import log is grouped by month. A single commit can't sit under three months, so I started it with the earliest one: `2025-10: fix category wholsale -> wholesale (also 2025-11, 2025-12)`. In the import log it will show up only under October. If you'd rather it go under another month, I can reword it.

**Still misspelled:** `inbox/2025-12.csv` has the same typo. Git doesn't track `inbox/`, so I left it alone; it doesn't affect anything already committed. Tell me if you want that copy fixed too.

January wasn't touched.
